name: mycrew-specialists
description: Layer 3/6 — the specialists, called down into the work when a piece of it needs a trade of its own. Not a stage and not a watch: a lead dispatches one exactly as it dispatches a worker, and gets back the same four fields. The designer is the first — it decides the product's look by building it, extending the visual language where one exists and founding one where it does not, and it never leaves a mockup behind.
